# Recreation Prompt

Create **Button Door Brave**, a mobile-first portrait browser canvas game based on these preserved mechanics: top-down joystick movement, grab nearby collectible, directional attack arc, enemies pursue and damage on contact, defeated enemies add score, collectibles persist in an index, three health units lead to defeat and restart.

Remix it into: Coraline button-eyed dark fantasy. A Coraline button-eyed dark fantasy game with uncanny domestic horror, alternate-world temptation, handcrafted eeriness, child bravery, sinister wonder, and storybook nightmare design with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The public surface should show a handmade Other House: stitched wallpaper, dollhouse windows, button moons, thread paths, yellow-raincoat child focal actor, crawling button-handed hazards, charm collectibles, candlelight attack feedback, readable portrait HUD, large thumb controls, and storybook nightmare menu copy.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The source game is a self-contained browser/canvas top-down survival arcade game. The player uses a left virtual joystick or keyboard to move through a bounded world, collects nearby relics with a grab button, attacks enemies with a right-side action button, loses health on enemy contact, gains score from defeated enemies, persists discovered collectibles, and can restart after defeat.

## Protected Mechanics
- Continuous canvas loop with camera follow and world bounds.
- Left joystick / keyboard movement semantics.
- POCKET/GRAB button claims a nearby collectible within the preserved radius.
- CANDLE/attack button emits a directional arc using preserved cooldown, reach, knockback, and damage semantics.
- Enemy contact removes one health unit with invulnerability timing.
- Defeating enemies grants 100 score and may spawn a collectible.
- Three-health defeat state, restart, menu return, and persistent collection drawer remain intact.

## Remixed Target
Coraline button-eyed dark fantasy. A Coraline button-eyed dark fantasy game with uncanny domestic horror, alternate-world temptation, handcrafted eeriness, child bravery, sinister wonder, and storybook nightmare design with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The new game, **Button Door Brave**, reframes the same loop as a brave child surviving an uncanny Other House. Movement is creeping through rooms, collectibles are handmade charms, enemies are stitched button-handed familiars, score is Courage Stitches, health is Brave Buttons, and defeat is the Other Mother closing in.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD copy, title, menus, procedural drawing, background motifs, entity silhouettes, palette, typography, audio URLs, particle colors, localStorage naming, and collection names are safe to transform. Core loop mechanics are not changed.
